description: Source code for KafkaRecordToRowConverter class, which converts Kafka ConsumerRecord objects to Spark InternalRow and UnsafeRow formats, with support for headers inclusion.

classes.name: KafkaRecordToRowConverter
classes.description: Class for converting Kafka ConsumerRecord to Spark InternalRow/UnsafeRow, with optional headers inclusion.

methods.name: toInternalRowWithoutHeaders
methods.description: Converts a Kafka ConsumerRecord to InternalRow without headers.

methods.name: toInternalRowWithHeaders
methods.description: Converts a Kafka ConsumerRecord to InternalRow including headers.

methods.name: toUnsafeRowWithoutHeadersProjector
methods.description: Projects a Kafka ConsumerRecord to UnsafeRow without headers.

methods.name: toUnsafeRowWithHeadersProjector
methods.description: Projects a Kafka ConsumerRecord to UnsafeRow including headers.

methods.name: toUnsafeRowProjector
methods.description: Returns a projector function for UnsafeRow, including headers based on parameter.
